What TMR Has Recorded
Independently tracked public handicapper.

Tracked Handicapper #0169 is an X account whose public picks TMR tracks independently. TMR is not affiliated with this handicapper and does not take picks from them directly: it reads what they post in public, records each pick with the time it was posted, and grades it from the final score at a flat one unit per pick.

TMR has graded 192 picks from Tracked Handicapper #0169, the first posted on Sep 14, 2026 and the most recent on Oct 26, 2026. The tracked record is 97-92-3 for −3.21u and −1.7% ROI, winning 51.3% of decided picks. The average price was −108 across 192 priced picks, 192 of them at a price the handicapper posted.

How Closing Line Value Is Measured Here
TMR records the closing price as the last price its odds collector saw within 10 minutes before the scheduled start, from one book in a fixed priority order (DraftKings first). CLV is calculated only when that close is at the exact line the handicapper posted, and only for picks that posted a price. Avg CLV (posted price) compares the posted price to the closing price as quoted, so it still includes the book's hold. Avg CLV (no vig) removes that hold using both sides of the same book's closing market and appears only where both sides were captured. This is one book's close, not a market wide consensus, and it does not cover player props.
